text: Neurite [Gr. neurithV ]: Ger. Neurit (Rauber), Neuraxon (Kölliker); Fr. cylindre-axe ; Ital. cilindrasse . The main or cellifugal process of a nerve-cell. Cf. DENDRITE, and NEUROCYTE. The neurite, or 'axis-cylinder' process, is commonly more simple than the dendrite, though not devoid of collaterals, and ending sooner or later in free arborizations or an END-ORGAN (q.v.). ( H.H. )
